records.title: Counteraction-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for General Capability Recovery with Domain Preservation
records.reason: Primary paper proposes multi-teacher on-policy distillation for recovering model capability; the method is post-training/model training, not inference serving efficiency.

records.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
records.reason: Primary paper proposes anti-self-distillation for reasoning RL; the contribution concerns the RL training objective and does not target inference compute, memory, or serving.

records.title: TokenGS: Decoupling 3D Gaussian Prediction from Pixels with Learnable Tokens
records.reason: Primary text identifies its task as feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from posed images and proposes learnable Gaussian tokens/3D scene prediction. Its attention/token terminology and test-time optimization refer to 3D vision reconstruction, not language-model attention kernels or inference.

records.title: Language-Conditioned World Modeling for Visual Navigation
records.reason: Primary text studies language-conditioned embodied navigation using a diffusion world model/actor-critic and an autoregressive multimodal navigation model. Its inference-time comparison is for visual robot navigation; it does not propose or evaluate the linked LLM post-training quantization/compression technique.

records.title: FireRed-OCR Technical Report
records.reason: Primary report describes an OCR model/application and recognition benchmarks; it does not establish a general LLM inference optimization.
